prior_importants.description: The amendment's list of store writes that skip writeStoreFile leaves out three writes. `pup map --open` writes map.html and `pup report` writes report.html and one dossier HTML per session. All three are at the store root and use plain writeFileSync, which follows a link (src/cli/index.ts:3081-3106).

The amendment leaves out the Bash re-check hook's before-snapshot writes under sessions/<id>/compiled/bash-snapshots (mkdir -p, mktemp -d, mv, rm -f in profile-compiler.service.ts:1144-1261). They skip writeStoreFile, and their mkdir -p follows a link.

findings.description: The bash-snapshots bullet says a planted link 'can only move the directory, or one snapshot … to where the link points' and 'does not write through to an existing file'. But the `mv` at profile-compiler.service.ts:1241 moves a regular file (`$WORK/before`). A link at `bash-snapshots/<id>` that points at a directory drops it there as `before`, and that replaces any existing file of that name. A link at `bash-snapshots` itself only redirects the `mktemp -d` scratch directory. Reword the sentence to say this.
